_source.what: Literal substitutions applied to the query statements at SF0.1 only (ADR-0247). Upstream chose its literals on SF1; at SF0.1 these 14 queries found nothing while their SF1 answers have rows, a non-zero count or true.
_source.rule: Each [from, to] pair replaces the one occurrence of `from` in the statement (the query file without its header); a pair that matches zero or several times is an error. Only literals change. The SF0.1 answer has the shape of upstream's SF1 answer; as few literals as possible change; a value is replaced by one of the same kind.
